name: Whispers of Desire
source:
At the heart of this story are Sarah and Alex, a happily married couple embarking on a new chapter of their lives. As they settle into fresh opportunities and social circles, unexpected desires and challenges arise, testing the strength of their bond.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/mr_fable/about]Patreon[/url]]
